exposure: prenatal diagnosis of Trisomy 13 or Trisomy 18
outcome: parental decisions (termination, induction with palliative care, expectant management, full interventions)
cohort: Participants were families with a prenatal diagnosis of Trisomy 13 or Trisomy 18 between 2000 and 2016 at a single center.
finding: The majority of women who continue their pregnancy after a fetal diagnosis of Trisomy 13 or 18 desire expectant management with palliative care, with a live birth expected in at least half of these cases.
